code: size_t CAPSTONE_API cs_disasm(csh ud, const uint8_t *buffer, size_t size, uint64_t offset, size_t count, cs_insn **insn)
note: The candidate bytes after the architecture selector are passed as the disassembly buffer and control the X86 instruction decoded by the library.
The x64 platform selected by the first input byte causes the remaining bytes to be decoded as a 64-bit X86 instruction.
The decoded internal instruction is translated into the MCInst operands that the printer will later consume.
The translated MCInst is handed to the architecture printer with detail mode enabled.
The printer assumes the generated memory operand starts at an operand index with a complete five-element memory tuple and does not verify that the requested operand index is within MI->size.
For the malformed decoded instruction, the printer reads an operand slot selected by the generated print path, causing an invalid/uninitialized operand read during operand formatting.
